question: Which keyless or free-tier translation routes remain beyond these three: Microsoft Azure AI Translator free tier (listed on free-for.dev as Cognitive Services), Amazon Translate free tier, Cloudflare Workers AI translation models, and the undocumented keyless Google endpoint translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single?
